meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says ulw-execute, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动执行开发计划，并行调度多个子代理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你希望让代理按既定计划自动推进开发任务。
copy.tagline_en: Execute your development plan automatically while coordinating parallel subagents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to follow a defined plan and handle multiple subtasks in parallel.

howto.what: Claude会作为“编排者”运行:不亲自写代码或改文件,而是读取你选中的工作计划,把每个任务拆成小块,并行派给多个子代理执行,自己负责跟踪进度、记录证据、勾选完成项,直到计划里所有任务都做完(可附带生成PR)。
howto.when: 在完成规划后,当你说出“ulw-execute”“execute plan”等触发词,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的某个计划时,它就会接管执行。

say.text: 执行 .omo/plans 里的工作计划
say.note: 它会读取计划并开始编排子代理。

say.text: 继续执行当前计划,完成剩余任务
say.note: 它会接着未完成的检查框继续派工。

say.text: 用 --make-pr 执行计划,完成后开PR
say.note: 它会新建工作树并在完成后提交PR。

howto.what_en: Claude acts solely as an orchestrator: it selects a plan, decomposes tasks, spawns parallel subagents to do all implementation, and tracks state/evidence/checkboxes until every task is done (optionally producing a PR).
howto.when_en: Triggered after planning when the user says 'ulw-execute', 'execute plan', etc., or asks to run a plan under .omo/plans.

say_en.note: It reads the plan and starts orchestration.

say_en.text: Continue the current plan and finish remaining tasks.
say_en.note: Resumes from the last unchecked checkbox.

say_en.text: Run the plan with --make-pr and open a PR when done.
say_en.note: Creates a worktree and hands off the PR.
